join_evidence.value: THE JOIN, RUN: stitch CONTAINS targets matched EXACTLY against the portal graph's own nodes[].id -- raw string, no parse, no normalisation on either side. |left| 12,352 CONTAINS edges (5,110 motif-sourced); |right| 11,232 portal node ids; |join| 1,512 EDGES over 1,495 DISTINCT TARGETS from 8 DISTINCT MOTIF SOURCES. THE UNITS ARE SAID BECAUSE THEY DIFFER: the face's floor is '1,402 edges' and neither 1,402 (vs 1,512 edges) nor '~10 percent' (vs 13.3 percent of 11,232 portal ids) reproduces. The concentration is the finding the coverage phrasing hides: all 1,512 edges originate from EIGHT motifs. OVERLAP AGAINST THE RATIFIED L2 SET, from org/tier1_exec/1.0.0_SA_CTO/deliverables/D11_L3_OVERLAP_VS_L2_20260829.json @62079fce55: reference = L2 STRUCTURE restricted to layer==portal (10,365); both 1,495 | store_only 0 | reference_only_not_reached 8,870 -- every portal symbol a motif reaches is inside the ratified set, and 8,870 portal-layer entities are reached by no motif (a wave-2 MISSING, not a zero). 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X reproduced the 1,495 independently on the id form this shard declares. EXISTENCE IS NOT CORRECTNESS: this row establishes that the join lands, not that any joined pair is semantically right.

failure_mode_downstream.value: If this bridge is wrong, wave 2 fuses motif members onto portal symbols they do not contain. THE OUTPUT IS DISTINGUISHABLE, and that is the difference from the sibling shard: the join is exact-string over two DECLARED id sets, so a wrong pair is a wrong string match and can be exhibited -- take any fused pair, look up the CONTAINS edge that produced it, and either it is in the store or it is not. The residual risk is not mis-attribution but COVERAGE: 8,870 of 10,365 portal-layer entities are reached by no motif, so a fusion over this bridge alone speaks for 14 percent of the plane and would look like a confident result over a small slice. The concentration sharpens it -- 8 motif sources produce every edge. A low-affinity result from THIS bridge should be read as 'the bridge did not reach it', which is a MISSING, and the count above is what distinguishes that from a genuine low affinity. This row asserts NO fused value.
